pages.title: The Team
pages.text: TerraFirma: Rebirth is created and maintained by the $(thing)Zhejiang University of Water Resources and Electric Power Minecraft Club$(), polished together with Minecraft clubs from several other universities.$(br2)From the 1.x era on 1.18, through 3.x on 1.20.1, to today's 4.x on 1.21.1 — this pack has grown alongside its players for years. Thank you for staying.

pages.text: $(li)Code support: $(thing)XinZhi$() (Bilibili), $(thing)Coin0804$() (CurseForge)$()$(br)$(li)Valuable feedback: $(thing)zombie_boy$()$()$(br)$(li)Testers: shiro, 墨乘风-, Lincoln, EchoesTFM, mingyue2024, ChiDeXing, 一只小白给a, MPC托马斯_official, 蒋鸽咕咕咕, me107107$()$(br)$(li)Special thanks: 猪人喜欢朋友$()$(br2)And every player who reported bugs or sent suggestions — this page can't hold all your names.

pages.title: Soundtrack Notice
pages.text: The pack ships $(thing)28 original TFCR tracks$(), released exclusively on $(thing)NetEase Cloud Music$().$(br2)Do not use, redistribute or re-upload the soundtrack outside TerraFirma: Rebirth content without permission.$(br2)Playing and creating is unaffected: streaming, videos and the community localization (non-commercial) are all welcome.

pages.title: Thanks to Mod Authors
pages.text: Our thanks to the authors of TerraFirmaCraft, Create, Immersive Engineering, Firmalife, AFC, Create: Aeronautics / Cosmonautics, and all 200+ mods and compat layers in the pack.$(br2)The full mod list is on the pack's release pages.$(br2)And thank you for reading this far — now go chop your first tree.
